services.name: Adp Summer Camp (1)
services.desc: In Theatre Horizon’s After School Drama Clubs, students are familiarized with the fundamentals of acting as they create and then perform their own original play. Led by professional teaching artists, students practice and develop the Connecting C’s: confidence & creativity, collaboration & communication, and community & care. Students meet for two hours once a week, and class culminates in a final showcase as students perform their world premiere original play for an audience of family and friends.
